async def act(page):
    # First, try to locate the 'Previous Post' link directly
    previous_post_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Previous Post')
    count = await previous_post_link.count()
    if count == 0:
        # Try case-insensitive substring match
        previous_post_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='previous post', exact=False)
        count = await previous_post_link.count()
    if count == 0:
        # Try partial match like 'Previous'
        previous_post_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Previous', exact=False)
        count = await previous_post_link.count()
    if count == 0:
        # If still not found, get all links and search for one with 'Previous Post' in name
        all_links = await page.get_by_role('link').all()
        for link in all_links:
            name = await link.get_attribute('aria-label') or await link.text_content()
            if name and 'previous post' in name.lower():
                previous_post_link = link
                count = 1
                break
    if count > 0:
        # Click the first matching link
        await previous_post_link.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        print("No 'Previous Post' link found on the page.")
